decision: Born from a cross-model review (codex) of why the 2026-06-05-001 Global-tools miss survived: the dashboard suite validates render helpers but is blind to the producer→served-state→shell-loader→scope→page-DOM→human chain. Verified the cited gaps in code: npm test is vitest-only + Playwright is Architecture-only; core-router.test.js copies a stale router (own loadState subset, never imports createJarvis); the nav test re-declares a SMALLER page list than core.js registers (omits repair/architecture/mission-control) because pageModules is a private const; setup.js shell says JARVIS + omits the project-selector container. Root cause = synthetic fixtures pre-bake the asserted shape, so cross-boundary contracts go untested.

Attribution sharpened (operator critical assessment): this is a QA-sufficiency gap in the PLATFORM, but the orchestrator had no sufficiency POLICY requiring real-state/real-shell coverage for dashboard features — it correctly ran the plan's tests + checked acceptance. The cure is to GIVE it that policy (F004 contract + advisory lint), not to expect emergent detection. Auto-detecting 'synthetic-only coverage' is a hard static-analysis problem; v0 is declarative + heuristic (warn), not a clever analyzer.

Sequenced by ROI + bounded-bootstrap discipline (per DontPanic's own no-meta-systems / demand-driven-planning memories). HIGHEST-ROI tier is CHEAPER than the reviewer's proposed full Playwright matrix: ~80% of the value (incl. THIS bug class) is reachable in jsdom by feeding PRODUCER-GENERATED state into the REAL createJarvis() shell. So v0 = de-drift harness (F001/F002) + one real-state→real-shell journey test (F003) + the sufficiency contract (F004). Playwright browser smoke (console errors, mobile overflow, real clipboard, layout/overlap across tabs+viewports), a11y/keyboard coverage, and platform-wide producer↔consumer contract generalization are EXPLICITLY DEFERRED, demand-gated (trigger: first jsdom-invisible layout/console regression, or operator demand). The reviewer's 'minimum gate' is the eventual target, not a minimum.

Keystone is F001: core.js exports createJarvis() but pageModules is PRIVATE, so tests can't reference the real nav/loader surface. Exporting pageModules de-drifts both the nav test and the loader test in one move. F003's fixture MUST be producer-generated (`dashboard build --project all`), never hand-authored — that is the whole anti-synthetic point — and a Python contract test guards fixture faithfulness so it can't silently go stale. The plan dogfoods its own thesis: its acceptance is anti-synthetic by construction.

EXPANDED from dashboard-only to surface-agnostic per operator directive ('does this cover website/app/Android/iOS... incorporate into an expanded plan'). Reassessment: the principle generalizes ('enter through the real surface the user/agent/external system uses'), but expansion must NOT become a universal QA-framework build. Kept the dashboard concrete instance (F001-F004) as the worked, shippable proof; ADDED the surface-agnostic MODEL as a convention doc (F005) + a declarative ADVISORY plan-review gate (F006). Bumped tier local->cross-cutting (now spans dashboard tests + a convention + a lint).

Critical sharpening of the codex framing: DontPanic GOVERNS, it does not execute most surfaces. It can run a CLI or a Node/jsdom test, but it cannot run an iOS simulator, an Android emulator, or another repo's browser suite in its own loop. So the cross-surface contract is enforced by requiring the plan to NAME the entering-surface proof (verified as a reference), with the PROJECT toolchain executing it — NOT by DontPanic running XCUITest/emulators (which codex's 'require XCUITest' implicitly assumed). Same 'missing contract, not missing execution' attribution as D002, applied at the surface level. Matches the DontPanic-governs / runtime-executes boundary.

v0 enforcement is DECLARATIVE + ADVISORY by design. The plan/feature DECLARES surface_class + NAMES matching proof; plan-review WARNS when a surface-claiming feature names none. Deferred (demand-gated, scope-out): full browser Playwright matrix, visual regression, DontPanic-orchestrated mobile/emulator runners, responsive/a11y gates, BLOCK-severity promotion, auto surface-class inference, and a synthetic-provenance static analyzer. Proof must MATCH THE CLAIM (no UI journey demanded when there is no user-facing claim). Considered splitting into a roadmap meta-plan + child (per the meta-planning-gap pattern); kept as ONE expanded plan because the added pieces are declarative (a doc + an advisory lint), not a built multi-surface harness — offered the split to the operator.

Operator chose ONE expanded plan over a 002+003 split (F005/F006 are declarative+advisory — a doc + a lint — not a built multi-surface harness, so they belong in this bootstrap). Pre-lock tightening (operator-directed): the cross-surface model is POLICY VOCABULARY, not an execution guarantee — 'DontPanic requires plans to NAME entering-surface proof for surface-facing claims; it does not necessarily RUN that proof unless the project toolchain exposes it locally; absence of execution is advisory in v0.' Avoids overpromising, especially iOS/Android (proof runs in the app's own CI). LOCK: status draft->active, pre_impl cleared by operator; build order F001->F006 (export shell symbols -> de-drift harness -> real-state journey -> dashboard contract -> surface model -> advisory lint). pre_merge remains the human gate; branch unmerged.

BUILD checkpoint: F001 DONE (core.js exports pageModules; drift-guard test asserts the full registered set incl repair/architecture/mission-control — green). F002 PARTIAL: (b) setup.js is now the real shell DOM (DontPanic brand + project-selector-container) and (c) the nav test drives imports + expectations from the exported pageModules (catches the omit-Repair/Architecture drift). Remaining F002(a): de-drift core-router.test.js (787 lines) to exercise createJarvis()'s real loadState — deferred to the next pass rather than risk a rushed surgical edit; confirmed the concrete drift (copy loads security as simple + omits architectureViewState/configInventory/skillRecommendations + the state-snapshot path that the real loader has). Full dashboard vitest 961 passed/45 files. F003-F006 still pending.
